status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
status.longComment: Spears was sidelined for Weeks 7 and 8 due to a knee injury but was cleared to play against the Jaguars in Week 10, when he turned four carries into 28 yards and failed to haul in his lone target. He was initially listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys after logging a full practice Friday, but the Titans have determined that a stint on injured reserve is warranted for the fourth-year running back. Spears will be required to miss at least the next four games, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Colts on Sunday, Dec. 20. Tony Pollard will continue to be the workhorse running back for the Titans while Julius Chestnut and rookie fifth-rounder Nicholas Singleton provide depth out of the backfield.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Moore (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
status.longComment: Moore may have picked up the injury during the third quarter, and he's being evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return. James Hudson figures to take over at left tackle in Moore's absence.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Harrell (knee) was taken to a hospital in Tampa on Saturday following a serious car accident, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.
status.longComment: Harrell is being monitored following Saturday's accident. The third-year pro tore his ACL in a preseason game against the 49ers in mid-August, which led to him being placed on season-ending injured reserve.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Flott (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against Dallas, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
status.longComment: Flott was hurt with just under six minutes remaining in the first half while tackling CeeDee Lamb. He was evaluated on the sideline and subsequently deemed questionable to return. Micah Robinson entered at cornerback in Flott's stead.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Adams (illness) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
status.longComment: Adams was added to the Titans' injury report right before the 1 p.m. ET kickoff due to the illness, and the veteran safety wasn't able to take any snaps before being ruled out for Sunday's contest. Terrell Burgess drew the start at safety alongside Kevin Winston in Adams' absence, per Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Burgess (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
status.longComment: Burgess injured his knee early in the second half, and he will be sidelined for the rest of Sunday's contest. He was filling in for Tony Adams (illness) at safety, so Isaiah Oliver is the next man up for the Titans.
